[SWS_DM_00122] UDS response behavior on not allowed clear opera- tions
⌈
If a DTC clear operation is requested and the DTC clear operation shall clear a
DTC with a forbidden clear allowance according to [SWS_DM_00896], the Diagnos-
tic Server instance shall send a negative response 0x22 (conditionsNotCorrect)
in the following situations:
• it was requested to clear a single DTC and the DTC could not be cleared accord-
ing to [SWS_DM_00896]
• it was requested to clear a DTC group and all the DTCs of the DTC group could
not be cleared according to [SWS_DM_00896]
(This doesn’t apply when one or more DTC are allowed to be cleared.)
⌋
